documents: Disposal instructions for credit to account

signing.note: Signed as per Bank record with company seal. Submit at Trade Desk or via digital channel.

channels.title: HDFC Bank NetBanking
steps: Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking.
Navigate to Trade Services or TradeOnNet (digital channel).
Upload the signed EDF letter and supporting export invoice pack.
Confirm the digital submission menu path with your branch as HDFC's public trade documentation does not specify the exact services-EDF upload path.

channels.title: Email to Branch or Relationship Manager
steps: Open the email draft to your branch or Relationship Manager.
Attach the downloaded EDF PDF, the invoice XLSX annexure, and the supporting invoices zip.
Send before {dueDate} and request an acknowledgement email or reference number.
Save the bank's written acknowledgement and upload it back to Korra.

channels.title: HDFC Bank Branch Trade Desk
steps: Print the signed EDF request letter and attach your company seal.
Include the multi-invoice XLSX annexure and supporting invoices / contract copies.
Submit at the Trade Desk of your HDFC Bank branch before 3:00 PM for same-day processing.
Collect the stamped acknowledgement copy and upload it to Korra.

email.subject: EDF Submission - {month} - HDFC Bank (AD Code: {adCode})
email.intro: Please find attached our Export Declaration Form (EDF) request letter and supporting export invoice documents for {month} under FEMA 23(R).
